speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify the timing of your symptoms: did your double vision and weakness start suddenly or gradually? Additionally, do you experience any difficulty swallowing or speaking?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for those details; the pattern you describe is very specific. I want to check your eye movements more closely to see if your eyelids also weaken: can you hold your head up straight for 60 seconds, and will your double vision get worse? Also, do you experience any drooping of your eyelids (ptosis)?

REQUEST TEST: Blood_chemistry (specifically Creatine_Kinase and electrolytes)

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal blood chemistry helps rule out metabolic causes; now, please rate your fatigue on a scale of 1 to 10, and can you confirm if your double vision improves after resting your eyes in a dark room? REQUEST IMAGES: CT_Head_with_contrast

text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs.
